## BlankPass

A **blank passcode keypad**: the numbers and letters on the Lock Screen passcode buttons are hidden, so only the circles show.

- The buttons, the passcode dots, Emergency and Cancel work exactly as before.
- Pressing a button doesn't reveal its number either.
- Only the Lock Screen keypad changes: other number pads (Phone, Settings) are untouched.
- **No settings.** Install, respring, done. To turn it off, uninstall it.

- **arm64 and arm64e** (A12 and newer) builds, made with Xcode's toolchain and checked for the correct arm64e format.
- Tested on an **iPhone 7 (A10)** with iOS 15.8.6 and Dopamine. Also tested on an **iPhone SE (2nd gen, A13)** with iOS 17.5.1 (arm64e), so **A12 and newer are confirmed**. iOS 16 isn't confirmed yet: please [report back](https://github.com/Jond-ie/repo/issues). If it puts you into safe mode, open Sileo (safe mode still allows it) and uninstall it.

- Make sure you know your passcode by heart: the keypad layout is the standard one (1 2 3 / 4 5 6 / 7 8 9 / 0).
- Only for rootless jailbreaks with ElleKit (Dopamine).
Written from scratch by **John d_ie**. Concept from the original **BlankPass** by **VladGeek** (Packix).
